title: Edit details panel
question: Same EventHubPanel drawer. How should the form read, and how quiet should TipTap be?

options.label: Sectioned + bubble editor
options.thesis: Luma-like sections: Basic (untitled title + description), Time (start/end + registration deadline), Location, Booking (sport, capacity, price, form, link). TipTap has no sticky bar—formatting appears as a bubble on text selection only (bold, italic, list, link).
options.viewport: Right drawer: large title field, seamless description, grouped time block, location, then booking fields; yellow Update event saves everything.
options.risk: Bubble menus can feel hidden if organisers never select text.

options.label: Sectioned + tiny inline bar
options.thesis: Same Luma sections and full Sportshub fields. TipTap keeps a compact non-sticky toolbar inside the description field only (bold, italic, list, link)—never sticky to the viewport.
options.viewport: Description shows a quiet one-row control strip under the label; scroll never floats a bar over Time/Location.
options.risk: Even a tiny bar adds header the reference avoided.

options.label: Fluid stream + bubble editor
options.thesis: No section labels—one continuous stack (title → description → time → location → booking fields) with hairline spacing only. TipTap bubble-on-selection; Update event saves all fields.
options.viewport: Drawer feels like one long document; Sportshub fields stay, just without Basic/Time/Location headers.
options.risk: Longer Sportshub field list can feel unbounded without section anchors.
